biography:
Thomasene has always considered herself an artist in the way that she views the world. She began painting with oils in her 50s and found a great passion!

Her favorite subjects are children and animals. She loves the way a small gesture of a child translates into a story. Stories are important to her and being able to tell them in pictures is a delight.

Her goal is to bring inspiration and joy to those who view and own her artwork.
